day_shape: 61 items dominated by IDF ground push into southern Lebanon with multiple evacuation orders and Hezbollah rocket/drone fire on Kiryat Shmona and the Galilee, IRGC asserting Strait of Hormuz transit control, and regime claims of Chinese military aid during recent US–Iran conflict; nothing from UK Parliament, OFAC, IAEA or State Department.

threads.label: Israel-Hezbollah fighting in south Lebanon
threads.summary: The IDF issued multiple evacuation orders for villages north of the Litani and said it struck a Hezbollah artillery command centre at Burj al-Shamali, while Hezbollah rockets hit Kiryat Shmona's commercial centre and drones struck near Shomera. Defa Press cited Haaretz calling the Israeli army in Lebanon 'strategiless' and claimed Marjayoun fell without resistance.

threads.label: Strait of Hormuz transit controls
threads.summary: IRGC-linked Khatam al-Anbiya headquarters said all vessels must transit designated routes with IRGC Navy permission, and Defa Press reported 20 vessels passed under IRGC coordination. Defa Press also quoted Qatar's deputy PM saying tensions cut transit by 80 percent and temporary passage charges are negotiable.

threads.label: Gaza operations and humanitarian framing
threads.summary: Times of Israel reported Hamas warned of 'dangerous escalation' after the Israeli PM ordered the army to seize more Gaza land, and that two years of war has fuelled rises in young-girl marriages. Jerusalem Post and Times of Israel also carried Nir Oz security training and Rimon Farms PTSD fundraising pieces.

threads.label: Iran-US confrontation claims
threads.summary: Jerusalem Post cited an NBC News report claiming Chinese military technology supported Iran during its recent conflict with the United States. Defa Press said Mohsen Rezaei accused Trump of 'betraying diplomacy for the third time' over the continuing naval blockade, and claimed an 'Orbiter' drone was downed over Qeshm.

threads.label: Iran domestic governance and economy
threads.summary: IRIB carried Pezeshkian on water-crisis efficiency, the inspection chief on 52,000 vehicles stuck at Saipa, and Tehran governor citing 900 unfinished provincial projects needing 20 trillion tomans. Defa Press framed 'economic reconstruction' as Iran's most important field of governance after war and sanctions pressure.

threads.label: Iranian military and security posture
threads.summary: Defa Press announced the unveiling of the '27 Rajab' fast attack speedboat in Tehran and reported Admiral Siyari's visit to the Imam Khomeini Maritime Science University in Nowshahr. The border guard commander reported two opposition fighters killed in Chaldoran, and intelligence police announced a Tehran espionage arrest linked to alleged Mossad contacts.

threads.label: Regional diplomacy and Yemen
threads.summary: Defa Press quoted Foreign Minister Araghchi calling solidarity of Islamic countries a 'guarantee of peace' and parliament's security chief Azizi citing the Supreme Leader's message on parliamentary diplomacy. Defa Press also reported the death of former Yemeni president Abdrabbuh Mansour Hadi at 81 in Riyadh.

I felt my heart break; it was as if the sky had torn open.

events.summary_en: Mysterious death of 'Abdrabbuh Mansour Hadi' in Riyadh; 'Abdrabbuh Mansour Hadi', former president of Yemen, died at age 81 in Riyadh. Sources from the government based in Aden announced to the French news agency that Hadi died following a sudden health crisis in the Saudi capital. Yemen's former president stepped down from the presidency in 2022 and has since lived in Riyadh under strict limitations and conditions similar to house arrest. Some sources told Arab media that Hadi's body will be buried in Riyadh on Friday. The Ansarullah movement has not formally issued a reaction, although one of its spokespersons referred to his death in 'difficult circumstances'.

events.summary_en: Economic reconstruction; the most important field of governance; After passing through war and widespread security and economic pressures, the most important issue facing Iran is not merely consolidating military deterrence but rather passing through economic attrition and entering the phase of national reconstruction. In such circumstances, the concept of 'resistance economy' has returned once again to the centre of the country's political and governance discourse but this time not merely as an economic slogan but as a roadmap for post-war Iran. A society that sees its economic future as murky gradually experiences decline in social hope and erosion of psychological capital. Conversely, if people feel the country has entered the phase of reconstruction and moving forward, the capacity to bear pressure increases.

events.title_en: End of espionage activities with arrest of suspect in Tehran; Intelligence police announced: An individual has been arrested on preliminary charges of espionage.
events.summary_en: End of espionage activities with arrest of suspect in Tehran; Intelligence police announced: An individual has been arrested on preliminary charges of espionage. Evidence and documents extracted from the suspect's mobile phone were examined in the investigation process and included matters such as communication in Telegram space with an opposition network with the alleged aim of membership in Mossad and also two-way communication with an individual outside the country; communication which raised the possibility of planning a bioterrorism operation in upcoming ceremonies. The suspected motivation in this case was also cited as departure from the country. Intelligence police warn that any cooperation, communication or activity in suspicious and affiliated spaces are subject to legal consequences and individuals engaging in such activities will face prosecution.

events.title_en: Ghazal by Reza Esmaili for the 'Martyred Leader'
events.summary_en: Reza Esmaili dedicated his latest composition entitled 'Impatient for your sight...' to the martyred leader of the Islamic Revolution, Ayatollah Sayed Ali Hosseini Khamenei. My heart is a wounded dove, beneath the rubble of sorrow from not seeing you, oh beloved! How difficult it is. How I remember the season of seeing you. To sing of you, there are many pretexts. By your side, the ghazal clings like Hafiz. By your side, the word of love is the finest work. Guardian of poetry and in harmony with poets within the chamber of your eye, poetry market is. You who became renowned for practising love, and from praising your name, love is unavoidable. You taught us the journey to the peak of art, so after you the path to reaching the summit is smooth. A fresh ghazal for you...
